post.description: Requires an l1-room-submit service principal immutably bound to the exact tenant, room, chain, RoomManager, and operations signer. post.summary: Bind ordered member/DA/aggregate proof lineage and durably publish RoomManager.submitAggregate as one type-3 transaction
post.description: Requires an l1-aggregate-submit service principal immutably bound to the exact tenant, chain, RoomManager, and aggregate signer. The owner loads every content-addressed member prepare/prove/verify result, each optional DA equivalence lineage, and the recursive aggregate receipt from one correlation, enforces 1 through 8 distinct tenant rooms sharing one deploymentDomain, at most six aggregate-contiguous blobs whose manifests exactly equal the rebuilt KZG sidecar bundle, substitutes the verified aggregate seal, then archives the bundle and journals exact calldata before signing.

post.summary: Durably publish one permit-bound sponsored RoomPool escrow mutation
post.description: Requires an l1-pool-sponsor service principal immutably bound to the exact tenant, chain, RoomPool, sponsor signer, and sponsorshipId, plus active immutable hosted sponsorship terms naming the beneficiary tenant. reserveAndStartForWithDataAvailabilityWithPermit starts a sponsored room with an explicit DA policy; renewRoomForWithPermit renews only after the owner rechecks the canonical allocation fact and hash-bound allocationState.user through two independent RPC providers. The permit is caller-signed ERC-2612 data whose value must cover the immutable maxTokenCharge; the owner encodes the pinned selector and journals exact calldata before signing. Unused-escrow refunds are enforced on-chain to the immutable payer.
